messages.subject: Transformations
parts:
G'day,

Yes, I am glad of all the new features, and I believe that Graham has
more in mind too, he does keep telling me he is just one person, but
he does get these updates out almost daily, from his home webpage.

I was wondering how people are dealing with the transformations.
Graham was nice enough to put a transformation I developed into
Rattle. However, to score the dataset, I need to transform both the
score_dataset as well as the train-test_dataset. I was wondering if
any one is using transformations in Rattle and how they are dealing
with difficult of transforming both, in the exact same way, so the
variable names align.

Regards
Tony
